scratch_candidates.runner_source:
import json,subprocess,statistics,hashlib,bisect
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
base=root/'cross/rust/target/release/palim-scale-competitor-probe'
fold=root/'fold-probe/target/release/palim-scale-competitor-probe'
pos=root/'positional-probe/target/release/palim-scale-competitor-probe'
configs=[('scalar-guards-100000','optimized',base,fold),('file_migrations_move_copy_5000','optimized',base,fold),('disjoint-20000','optimized',base,fold),('small-config-edit','optimized',base,fold),('shuffle-2000','plain',base,pos)]
records=[]
for rep in range(3):
 for case,mode,before,after in configs:
  order=[('baseline',before),('candidate',after)];order=order[rep%2:]+order[:rep%2]
  for variant,binary in order:
   output=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(binary),mode,str(root/'cross/fixtures'/f'{case}.json')],text=True))
   wire=output.pop('wire');output.update(case=case,variant=variant,mode=mode,repeat=rep,wire_sha256=hashlib.sha256(wire.encode()).hexdigest())
   output['core_ms']=statistics.median(output['core_samples_ms']);output['pipeline_ms']=statistics.median(output['pipeline_samples_ms']);records.append(output)
   print(rep,case,variant,round(output['core_ms'],4),output['wire_bytes'],flush=True)
(root/'candidate-records.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
summary=[]
for case,mode,_,_ in configs:
 for variant in ['baseline','candidate']:
  rows=[r for r in records if r['case']==case and r['variant']==variant]
  assert len({r['wire_sha256'] for r in rows})==1
  summary.append(dict(case=case,mode=mode,variant=variant,core_ms=statistics.median(r['core_ms'] for r in rows),pipeline_ms=statistics.median(r['pipeline_ms'] for r in rows),core_process_medians=[r['core_ms'] for r in rows],wire_bytes=rows[0]['wire_bytes'],wire_sha256=rows[0]['wire_sha256'],operations=rows[0]['operations'],operation_counts=rows[0]['operation_counts'],self_verified=all(r['self_verified'] for r in rows)))
(root/'candidate-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
f=json.loads((root/'shuffle-2000.json').read_text());index={v:i for i,v in enumerate(f['left'])};tails=[]
for v in f['right']:
 i=index[v];at=bisect.bisect_left(tails,i)
 if at==len(tails):tails.append(i)
 else:tails[at]=i
print('shuffle LIS',len(tails),'of',len(index))
